tools.name: list_board_cards
tools.description: The team's CVE board: the CVEs that reached this team (by tracking notification or added by hand), each with its triage status (new, acknowledged, in_progress, resolved, dismissed), resolution status, notes, severity and the vendor/product it was recorded against. tools.name: list_trackings
tools.description: The vendors, products, versions, CVEs, keywords and CPEs this account's team is watching in VulnTracker.

tools.name: lookup_cve
tools.description: Full record for one CVE: description, CVSS, EPSS, KEV/exploitation and SSVC, affected products with version ranges and fixes from the ledger, vendor advisories (CSAF), public exploit repositories, and VulnTracker's remediation guide when one is published.

tools.name: product_cves
tools.description: All CVEs recorded against a product in the affected-version ledger, newest first, with the version ranges each one names. entry_kind 'affected' = the product itself is vulnerable; 'runs_on_platform' = another product is vulnerable when running on it.

tools.name: product_versions
tools.description: List the versions VulnTracker knows for a product, with per-version CVE and fix counts. Use to find the exact version string before calling check_version.

tools.name: remediation_guide
tools.description: VulnTracker's published remediation guide for a CVE: summary, steps, workarounds, caveats, kind (fix / workaround / guidance) and the fix versions it rests on. Returns has_guide=false when none is published.

tools.name: search_cves
tools.description: Search the CVE list with filters. Results are newest first, up to 100 per call; when has_more is true pass next_cursor back as 'cursor' for the following page (at most 10 pages per filter set, so narrow the filters instead of walking the whole database). 'tracked_only' limits to CVEs matching the AP

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find VulnTracker products (software, firmware, libraries) by name. Returns slugs to use with check_version, product_versions and product_cves. Searches display names and known aliases (package names, CPE tokens).

tools.name: track
tools.description: Start watching something in VulnTracker for the API key's team: a product (default; slug or id from search_products / check_dependencies matched_slug), a vendor, a single CVE, or a keyword. tools.name: untrack
tools.description: Remove a tracking from the API key's team: give the same type and target used with track (or shown by list_trackings). Board cards stay.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "product_versions" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the versions VulnTracker knows for a product, with per-version CVE and fix counts. Use to find the exact version string before calling check_version.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
